title: Protected daily blog merge does not immediately trigger original public release proof
root_cause: The original daily blog workflow was scheduled hourly and triggered on publisher/script changes only; merged blog/<slug>/index.html did not trigger it. Its successful 2026-11-13 07:50 UTC run preceded PR #5718's protected merge and Netlify 08:18 READY deploy. At 08:19 the canonical original blog obligation remained APPROVED, no provider ID, live_proven_at or public HTTP evidence. A successful earlier scheduled run is insufficient receipt for later source.
fix: In the SAME original GitHub workflow, add a narrow protected-main push path for blog/*/index.html so the SAME guarded one-day original renderer/reconciler executes public proof on publication; keep original hourly fallback and concurrency. Update existing agent and recovery skill with exact proof requirements and a deterministic regression. No added publisher/scheduler/provider, no blind state update.
prevention_rule: Any protected merged daily blog must cause a same-owner immediate consumer proof attempt; no publication LIVE_PROVEN until exact GH ancestry, production deploy ID/SHA, public 200 HTML with matching canonical/content-ID and original Supabase receipt. Externally observable status remains open until independently verified.
